reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years because client confidentiality is non-negotiable, and I am terrified of data leaks involving PAN and ITR records. Even with files residing in Google Drive, I cannot risk paying for software until I personally verify that an assistant accidentally moving or deleting folders won't cause permanent file loss or corruption.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and how do I know connecting external software won't expose our confidential client data?
would_change_my_mind: Hands-on proof during the free pilot demonstrating that 1-click folder restoration works when an assistant tampers with Drive folders, alongside verifiable proof that zero files outside the /Docketra/ folder are accessible.
